title.zh: 卷六十四 表第四 方鎮一
title.raw: 卷六十四 表第四 方鎮一 Volume 64 Tables 4: Military Commanderies 1

sentences.zh: 高祖、太宗之制，兵列府以居外，將列衛以居內，有事則將以征伐，事已各解而去。

translations.literal: Under the institutions of Gaozu and Taizong, armies were arrayed through prefectures to dwell outside, while generals were arrayed through guards to dwell within; when there was need the generals undertook campaigns, and when the affair was done each disbanded and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Under the systems of Emperors Gaozu and Taizong, troops were stationed in prefectural armies posted outside the capital, while commanders were grouped in guard units stationed within; when need arose the generals would campaign, and once the task was finished each force disbanded and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 兵者，將之事也，使得以用，而不得以有之。

translations.literal: Soldiers are the matter of generals; they were enabled to use them, yet not enabled to possess them.
translations.idiomatic: Troops belonged to the generals' command—they could deploy them in service, but not claim them as their own.

sentences.zh: 及其晚也，土地之廣，人民之衆，城池之固，器甲之利，舉而予之。

translations.literal: When it reached its later period, the breadth of land, the multitude of people, the solidity of walled cities, and the sharpness of armor and weapons—all were raised up and given away.
translations.idiomatic: By the dynasty's later days, vast territories, large populations, fortified cities, and superior arms were all handed over wholesale.

sentences.zh: 何慮於其始也深，而易於其後也忽，如此之異哉？

translations.literal: Why was consideration at the beginning so deep, yet change in the later period so sudden—how such a difference!
translations.idiomatic: Why was precaution so thorough at the outset, yet reform so abruptly abandoned afterward—what a striking contrast!

sentences.zh: 豈其弊有漸，馴而致之，勢有不得已而然哉？

translations.literal: Was it not that the evil had a gradual course, and was tamed until it arrived—were there circumstances that could not be avoided and made it so?
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps the decline came by degrees, gently leading to this end—was it not a situation that could scarcely have been otherwise?

sentences.zh: 方鎮之患，始也各專其地以自世，旣則迫於利害之謀，故其喜則連衡而叛上，怒則以力而相并，又其甚則起而弱王室。

translations.literal: The affliction of the military prefectures: at first each monopolized its territory to perpetuate itself; once that was done, pressed by schemes of gain and loss, when pleased they joined in alliance and rebelled against the sovereign, when angered they used force to annex one another; at its most extreme they rose up and weakened the royal house.
translations.idiomatic: The trouble with the frontier commanderies began when each clique monopolized its region as a hereditary fief; once entrenched and driven by calculations of profit and loss, they allied against the throne when it suited them, fought one another by force when provoked, and at worst rose up to enfeeble the imperial house.

sentences.zh: 唐自中世以後，收功弭亂，雖常倚鎮兵，而其亡也亦終以此，可不戒哉！

translations.literal: From the mid-period of Tang onward, though success in quelling disorder was often achieved by relying on commandery troops, its fall too ultimately ended because of this—can one not take warning!
translations.idiomatic: From the mid-Tang period onward, though the court often drew on frontier armies to restore order and secure victory, the dynasty's fall too ultimately stemmed from this very reliance—should we not take warning!

sentences.zh: 作方鎮表。

translations.literal: The author composed the table of military commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: The compilers drew up the table of military commanderies.

sentences.zh: 表第四 方鎮表一

translations.literal: Table 4, Military Commanderies Table 1.
translations.idiomatic: Table 4: Military Commanderies, Part One.

translations.literal: Western calendar [CE]. Capital Region. Xing-Feng-Long. Jing-Yuan. Bin-Ning. Wei-Bei Fu-Fang. Shuofang. Eastern Capital Region.
translations.idiomatic: CE dates. Columns: Capital Region; Xing–Feng–Long; Jing–Yuan; Bin–Ning; Wei-Bei Fu–Fang; Shuofang; Eastern Capital Region.

translations.literal: 710, first year of the Jingyun era.
translations.idiomatic: 710 CE, first year of the Jingyun reign.

sentences.zh: 712 先天元年

translations.literal: 712, first year of the Xiantian era.
translations.idiomatic: 712 CE, first year of the Xiantian reign.

sentences.zh: 713 開元元年

translations.literal: 713, first year of the Kaiyuan era.
translations.idiomatic: 713 CE, first year of the Kaiyuan reign.

sentences.zh: 742 天寶元年 朔方節度增領邠州。

translations.literal: 742, first year of the Tianbao era. The Shuofang circuit added Bin Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 742, the first year of Tianbao, the Shuofang military commissioner gained jurisdiction over Bin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 763 廣德元年 罷鎮國軍節度。

translations.literal: 763, first year of the Guangde era. The Zhenguo Army circuit was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 763, the first year of Guangde, the Zhenguo Army military commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 懷州隸昭義，陝西觀察使增領虢州。

translations.literal: Huai Prefecture was placed under Zhaoyi; the Shanxi West observation commissioner added Guo Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Huai Prefecture was assigned to the Zhaoyi circuit, and the Shanxi West observation commissioner gained Guo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 766 大曆元年

translations.literal: 766, first year of the Dali era.
translations.idiomatic: 766 CE, first year of the Dali reign.

sentences.zh: 779 十四年 潁州隸永平節度使。

translations.literal: 779, fourteenth year. Ying Prefecture was placed under the Yongping military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 779, the fourteenth year of Dali, Ying Prefecture was transferred to the Yongping military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 復置邠寧慶節度使。

translations.literal: The Bin-Ning-Qing military commissioner was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The Bin–Ning–Qing military commissioner was reinstated.

sentences.zh: 罷渭北節度，置都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: The Wei-Bei circuit was abolished; a chief training and observation commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei–Bei military commissioner was abolished and replaced by a chief training and observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 析置河中、振武、邠寧三節度，朔方所領靈鹽夏豐四州、西受降城、定遠天德二軍。

translations.literal: Three circuits were carved out and established—Hezhong, Zhenwu, and Bin-Ning; what Shuofang held were Ling, Yan, Xia, and Feng prefectures—four in all—plus West Accept-the-Surrender Fortress, and the Dingyuan and Tiande armies—two in all.
translations.idiomatic: Hezhong, Zhenwu, and Bin–Ning were established as separate circuits, leaving Shuofang with four prefectures—Ling, Yan, Xia, and Feng—along with West Accept-the-Surrender Fortress and the Dingyuan and Tiande garrisons.

sentences.zh: 振武節度復領鎮北大都護府及綏銀二州、東中二受降城。

translations.literal: The Zhenwu circuit again held the Zhenbei Grand Protectorate and Sui and Yin prefectures—two in all—and the East and Central Accept-the-Surrender fortresses—two in all.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhenwu military commissioner regained the Zhenbei Grand Protectorate, Sui and Yin prefectures, and the eastern and central Accept-the-Surrender fortresses.

sentences.zh: 復置東畿觀察使，以留臺御史中丞兼之，復領汝州，廢陝西防禦觀察使。

translations.literal: The Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner was restored; the Left Censorate vice censor-in-chief at the eastern capital held the post concurrently; it again held Ru Prefecture; the Shanxi West defense and observation commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Capital Region observation commissioner was reinstated, filled concurrently by the Left Censorate vice censor-in-chief at Luoyang; Ru Prefecture was restored to his command and the Shanxi West defense and observation commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 780 建中元年

translations.literal: 780, first year of the Jianzhong era.
translations.idiomatic: 780 CE, first year of the Jianzhong reign.

sentences.zh: 783 四年 置京畿渭南節度觀察使，領金、商二州。

translations.literal: 783, fourth year. The Capital Region Wei-Nan military and observation commissioner was established, holding Jin and Shang prefectures—two in all.
translations.idiomatic: In 783, the fourth year of Jianzhong, a Capital Region Wei–Nan military and observation commissioner was created, commanding Jin and Shang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 是年，兼渭北、鄜坊、丹、延、綏五州。

translations.literal: In the same year, he concurrently held Wei-Bei, Fu-Fang, Dan, Yan, and Sui prefectures—five in all.
translations.idiomatic: That same year he also took charge of Wei–Bei, Fu–Fang, Dan, Yan, and Sui—five prefectures in all.

sentences.zh: 未幾，罷五州及金州，為京畿商州節度使。

translations.literal: Before long, the five prefectures and Jin Prefecture were abolished; he became military commissioner of the Capital Region Shang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Before long those five prefectures and Jin were removed from his charge; the post became military commissioner of the Capital Region Shang Prefecture circuit.

sentences.zh: 興鳳隴節度賜號保義節度。

translations.literal: The Xing-Feng-Long circuit was granted the title Baoyi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Xing–Feng–Long military commissioner was given the honorific name Baoyi circuit.

sentences.zh: 是年，罷保義，以隴州置奉義軍節度使，尋廢。

translations.literal: In the same year, Baoyi was abolished; the Long Prefecture Fengyi Army military commissioner was established; soon it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: That same year the Baoyi circuit was abolished and a Fengyi Army military commissioner was created at Long Prefecture; before long this too was abolished.

sentences.zh: 復置渭北節度，如上元之舊，尋罷。

translations.literal: The Wei-Bei circuit was restored, as in the old Shangyuan arrangement; soon it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei–Bei military commissioner was restored on the old Shangyuan model; before long it was abolished again.

sentences.zh: 未幾復置，徙治鄜州，其後置都團練觀察防禦使。

translations.literal: Before long it was restored again; the seat was moved to Fu Prefecture; afterward a chief training, observation, and defense commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: Before long it was reinstated with its seat moved to Fu Prefecture; later a chief training, observation, and defense commissioner was appointed.

sentences.zh: 罷觀察，置東畿汝州節度。

translations.literal: The observation commissioner was abolished; the Eastern Capital Region Ru Prefecture circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: The observation post was abolished and an Eastern Capital Region Ru Prefecture military commissioner was installed.

sentences.zh: 置陝西都防禦使，尋升為節度使。

translations.literal: The Shanxi West chief defense commissioner was established; soon he was promoted to military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: A Shanxi West chief defense commissioner was appointed and soon raised to military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 787 三年 罷保義節度，置都團練觀察防禦使。

translations.literal: 787, third year. The Baoyi circuit was abolished; a chief training, observation, and defense commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 787, the third year of Zhenyuan, the Baoyi circuit was abolished and a chief training, observation, and defense commissioner was installed.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復置節度，兼右神策軍行營節度使。

translations.literal: Before long, the circuit was restored; he concurrently held the Right Divine Strategy Army campaign military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the military commissioner was reinstated, concurrently commanding the Right Divine Strategy Army campaign.

sentences.zh: 初，隴右節度兵入屯秦州，尋徙岐州，及吐蕃陷隴右，德宗置行秦州，以刺史兼隴右經略 使，治普潤，以鳳翔節度使領隴右支度營田觀察使。

translations.literal: Initially, the Longyou circuit troops entered and encamped at Qin Prefecture; soon they moved to Qi Prefecture. When the Tibetans seized Longyou, Dezong established Acting Qin Prefecture, with the prefect concurrently holding the Longyou pacification commissioner, with seat at Purun; the Fengxiang military commissioner held the Longyou supply, garrison-fields, and observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At first Longyou troops were posted at Qin Prefecture and soon shifted to Qi; after the Tibetans overran Longyou, Dezong created an Acting Qin Prefecture whose prefect doubled as Longyou pacification commissioner at Purun, while the Fengxiang military commissioner took charge of Longyou supply, garrison-fields, and observation duties.

sentences.zh: 復置渭北節度使，以綏州隸銀夏節度。

translations.literal: The Wei-Bei military commissioner was restored; Sui Prefecture was placed under the Yin-Xia circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei–Bei military commissioner was reinstated, and Sui Prefecture was assigned to the Yin–Xia circuit.

sentences.zh: 置夏州節度觀察處置押蕃落使，領綏、鹽二州，其後罷領鹽州。

translations.literal: The Xia Prefecture military, observation, disposal, and frontier-tribal overseer commissioner was established, holding Sui and Salt prefectures—two in all; afterward Salt Prefecture was removed from its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: A Xia Prefecture military commissioner with frontier-tribal oversight was created, commanding Sui and Salt prefectures; later Salt Prefecture was withdrawn from his charge.

sentences.zh: 唐、鄧二州隸山南東道。

translations.literal: Tang and Deng prefectures—two in all—were placed under the Shannan East circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Tang and Deng prefectures were transferred to the Shannan East circuit.

translations.idiomatic: In 821, the first year of Changqing, the Eastern Capital Region defense commissioner relinquished Ru Prefecture.
